title: Merge Boxes! 2D
description: A re-creation of my old Roblox game "Merge Boxes!". It is now an incremental game rather than just a merge game, and it is also made in Love2D! The game is not finished yet, but I'd say it's pretty close!

title: TBB:TARPG
description: My most popular game, with over 1M visits across all its places and a peak of 183 concurrent players. TBB:TARPG is a roleplay game inspired by Tumore's The Battle Bricks. The game went through four different versions throughout its lifetime, each introducing various changes and improvements. It is currently private, as I no longer wish to associate myself with Tumore, their games, or their community. Clicking this project will take you to a page containing documentation and proof of the game's existence.

title: Merge Boxes!
description: A not-very-popular merge game where you merge boxes.. yup, that's about it. I had a LOT of fun making this game, which is why I'm remaking it (Merge Boxes! 2D)

title: mellowestmel.com
description: A place to check out my projects, socials, and whatever I'm working on.

title: Teapot Tumble
description: A remake of Clockwork's "Dodge the Teapots of Doom" (originally released December 15, 2007). Teapot Tumble expands the concept with a shop system, in-game currency, a speedrun timer, and a procedurally generated map that increases in difficulty as players win.

title: Same Day Shipping
description: Race against the clock in Same Day Shipping, a fast-paced multiplayer roguelike where every second counts as you rush to deliver packages before time runs out!

title: Class Warfare
description: Welcome to Class Warfare, a free-for-all fighting game where you battle using different morphs called classes. Each class uses Roblox gear from the catalog.

title: Gearbearers
description: My newest project and a successor to Class Warfare. It is currently private and I do not wish to reveal too much about it yet.

title: Slime TD
description: A tower defense game where you defend your base against waves of slimes using turrets. Development of this project never got very far, since it was my first ever Love2D project. It was abandoned after I came up with the idea for Merge Boxes! 2D.
